notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.40

• DuckWeb: fixed not being able to search again — tap the address bar and type a new search any time.
• Crash detection is now on by default (Settings › Medical ID › Safety to change). After a hard fall or crash it asks if you're OK and opens Emergency; it never calls by itself.
• Liquid Glass is clearer — the Start menu and quick panel frost the wallpaper more.
